items.title: 3 US Utility Stocks Built For Higher Interest Rates
items.summary: Markets are wrestling with sticky inflation data, fragile confidence readings and fresh GDP revisions, while the recent Nasdaq pullback reminds investors how quickly sentiment can flip. Higher-for-longer interest rates can punish stretched growth stories, yet sometimes reward sturdier, cash-paying stocks that handle pricier funding. This article looks at three U.S. value and dividend stocks exposed to these macro shocks and explains why each might deserve a closer look in the current...

items.title: How Many Shares of Duke Energy, Consolidated Edison or AEP Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes 2,765 shares of Duke Energy, 3,093 shares of American Electric Power or 3,381 shares of Consolidated Edison. Duke Energy costs the least, about $358,800, which is about $44,700 less than Consolidated Edison, but it pays out the most of its earnings: 67% of fiscal 2025 normalized EPS.
